episodes.164889: A cold front in the vicinity of South FL and a series of mid-level impulses promoted instability and thus convection over the nearshore Atlantic waters off the Miami-Dade County coast and right along the coast due to coastal convergence. This combined with lingering moisture and slow storm motion allowed for heavy rainfall and flooding to occur across portions of Miami-Dade County.
episodes.166081: Heavy rain brough flooding to some rivers in northeast Arkansas January 9-11, 2022.
episodes.166299: Shallow marine instability enabled convective showers to develop within strong north to northeast boundary layer flow behind a strong cold front, producing isolated gale-force wind gusts near the Upper Florida Keys.

events.county: Hawk Channel From Ocean Reef To Craig Key Out To The Reef
events.narrative: A northeast wind gust of 34 knots was measured at an automated WeatherFlow station at Carysfort Reef Light.
Heavy rainfall brought flooding to the White River at Clarendon January 11-28, 2022.

An off duty NWS meteorologist reported via social media and a phone call that flooding was ongoing at the intersection of SE 9th Avenue and SE 1st Street in downtown Miami. Video footage shows several inches of standing water on the roadway/curb as well as water entering the first floor of buildings. Water was halfway up car tires as well.
